visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged woman with short reddish-brown hair, glasses, and a tan blazer over a white blouse speaks directly into the camera from a professional office or clinic setting. A black microphone is clipped to her lapel. (2) The scene cuts to a split comparison showing extreme close-ups of human skin; the top half displays numerous red pustules labeled '痘痘', while the bottom half shows a textured pinkish surface labeled '蠕形蟎蟲'. (3) The camera returns to the woman, who holds up two fingers and gestures while circular graphic overlays appear on either side of her, showcasing magnified views of comedonal acne and inflammatory acne. (4) Close-up shots follow, alternating between irregular, blotchy acne on a cheek and more uniform, fine red bumps typical of mite infestation. (5) The woman points specifically to her eyebrow region while a magnifying circle graphic highlights small, crusty, yellowish debris on a patch of skin. (6) A series of close-ups show the process of extracting a small white plug from a pore, followed by another comparison of circular skin samples. (7) The woman holds two circular photographs side-by-side representing the two conditions as she explains their potential simultaneous occurrence. (8) The video concludes with a white graphic card featuring the DRX Dermatology Clinic logo, social media handles, and address information in a clean, professional layout.
